setup: The bipartite graph has left vertices [[left]], right vertices [[right]], and edges [[edges]].

steps.say: A matching pairs left and right vertices along edges, using each vertex at most once, so the search is over assignments rather than over edges.
Pairing as many as possible gives [[value]] pairs, and no matching of size one more exists because it would need more distinct right vertices than the edges allow.

answer: So the maximum matching has size [[value]].
